blocks.content: So far, we have used the fstream class to handle our file operations. However, we can also perform these tasks using the ifstream and ofstream classes. These classes are defined inside the <fstream> header file.
Let's look at some of the basic features of these classes.

rows:
Stands for Input File Stream.
Used for reading files.
Uses ios::in mode by default.

Stands for Output File Stream.
Used for writing/appending files.
Uses ios::out mode by default.
We need to pass ios::app as an argument for appending.
